description: Witness-log and verification-receipt-log sequences (SPEC-v2 §5.5, §5.6). The harness keeps caller-authenticated head state starting at the genesis head for initial_log_id (sequence 0, 48 zero bytes, no accepted digests). Each verify step checks the entry with the step key against the current head.

head_rules.appended: advance: sequence+1, head hash = StatementBodyDigest(code, entry body), record the digest at that sequence
head_rules.error: any other expected error class leaves the head unchanged
head_rules.log_fork: a different body digest at an accepted sequence; the caller durably freezes the log
head_rules.recover: start a new caller-authenticated log at log_id from the genesis head; the frozen log is not continued
head_rules.replay: exact accepted body digest at an accepted sequence; head unchanged

scenarios.name: witness_log
scenarios.description: append, idempotent replay, gap, orphan, cross-log replay, fork freeze, and recovery to a new log ID

scenarios.name: verification_receipt_log
scenarios.description: receipt idempotency by body digest, key substitution, gap, orphan, fork freeze, and recovery to a new log ID pinned to one verifier ID
